dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Although we may be able to negotiate with Stormterror, we'll most likely have to fight. Please be ready for it.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Some of Dawn Winery's wine is sold at Angel's Share, a local tavern.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I work the bar there sometimes. If you ever need to talk to me, feel free to find me there.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Otherwise, you might need to make an appointment with my butler.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I mostly decided to do it on a whim. Though I must say, that bard is quite intriguing.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Besides, it's bad for my business if we keep letting Stormterror do whatever it pleases.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Let me be clear though. I did it for you, not for the Knights.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Nothing more? We'll meet at Starsnatch Cliff then.
